grading_rules.decision: ANNOTATION_ONLY if map coverage of the zone < coverage_min; otherwise SOURCE_DERIVED_VERIFIED only when IoU >= iou_min AND every annotated portal of the zone is paired with a derived opening of width >= 2 x body radius AND the zone has 0 route violations; any other outcome is UNKNOWN. Thin features and unmatched derived openings are reported but do not change the grade. Seating hulls are graded separately (D11).

gt_policy: Route files are renderer ground truth, read for offline evaluation only; this record holds violation time/distance/zone and no route coordinates; nothing here modifies a map (CP1 D10).
deviations: Comparison domain (zone plus touching OBSTACLE annotations) was fixed after a first partial run on the Office map showed that the zone polygon alone hid a 66 m2 disagreement; the zone-polygon-only IoU is kept as iou_eroded_zone_polygon_only. Thresholds were not changed.
